title: UI风格#222 - Vintage Modern (复古现代)
description: 创建第222种UI风格：复古现代风格 - 复古元素+现代简约、旧时光新诠释。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planHO.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Vintage Modern style When color palette Then features muted pastels, cream, charcoal
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#E8E4E0 (奶油灰), #5D5D5D (炭灰), #D4A574 (焦糖), #F5F5F5 (柔白)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Vintage Modern style When typography Then uses vintage modern: Playfair Display, Montserrat
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Playfair Display (复古衬线), Montserrat (现代)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Vintage Modern style When layout Then retro proportions, modern grid, balanced asymmetry
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：复古比例、现代网格、平衡不对称

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Vintage Modern style When UI elements Then subtle textures, refined edges, warm shadows
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：微妙纹理、精致边缘、暖色阴影

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Vintage Modern UI When functional Then includes timeless chat, classic agents, balance stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：永恒聊天、经典代理、平衡统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Vintage Modern UI When copy Then uses timeless: 'Classic', 'Timeless', 'Balance', 'Refined'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'CLASSIC. TIMELESS. BALANCE.'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'REFINE'、'DEPLOY'→'BALANCE'
